purpose: Provenance for the ORT compilation command displayed on slide-htp-runtime. Read-only reconstruction; no build was run for the presentation.
invocation_note: The saved log records build.py's parsed arguments, not the outer shell invocation. The slide renders those exact arguments through the retained source tree's standard ./build.sh wrapper, with line wrapping and argument order adjusted. Run from the pinned ORT source in the prepared container. /opt/android-sdk, its NDK and /opt/qairt are container paths, not assumed workstation installations.
qualification: This records the initial QNN-enabled build. The later upstream Pad-selector bug-fix backport was a separate runtime change. --skip_tests skipped execution, but the broad initial build still compiled unit-test targets. This is not a minimal build recommendation, a new build result or a complete SDK installation guide.
